# {poorman}

[![CRAN
status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/poorman)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=poorman)
[![Dependencies](https://tinyverse.netlify.app/badge/poorman)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=poorman)
![CRAN
downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/poorman)[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/nathaneastwood/poorman/actions/workflows/check-standard.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/nathaneastwood/poorman/actions/workflows/check-standard.yaml)
[![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/nathaneastwood/poorman/branch/master/graph/badge.svg?token=YPQSSEEHZJ)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/nathaneastwood/poorman)

> I’d seen my father. He was a poor man, and I watched him do
> astonishing things. - Sidney Poitier

## Overview

{poorman} is a grammar of data manipulation, providing dependency free
versions of [{dplyr}](https://github.com/tidyverse/dplyr) verbs that
help you solve the most common data manipulation challenges:

- [`select()`](reference/select.md) picks variables based on their
  names.
- [`mutate()`](reference/mutate.md) adds new variables that are
  functions of existing variables.
- [`filter()`](reference/filter.md) picks cases based on their values.
- [`summarise()`](reference/summarise.md) reduces multiple values down
  to a single summary.
- [`arrange()`](reference/arrange.md) changes the ordering of the rows.

{poorman} attempts to replicate the {dplyr} API exactly such that your
{dplyr} code will still run even if you use {poorman} in its place. In
addition to replicating {dplyr} functionality, {poorman} implements
other functionality from the wider {tidyverse} such as select helpers
and the pipe, `%>%`.

For more details on the functionality available within {poorman}, check
out the {poorman} series of blog posts
[here](https://nathaneastwood.github.io/tags/poorman/).

([back to top](#readme-top))

## Compatibility

{poorman} replicates the behaviour of {dplyr} 1.0.x and {tidyr} 1.1.x.
Features added in later versions are not implemented.

([back to top](#readme-top))

## Installation

You can install:

- the development version from
  [GitHub](https://github.com/nathaneastwood/poorman) with

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("nathaneastwood/poorman")
```

- the latest release from CRAN with

``` r

install.packages("poorman")
```

([back to top](#readme-top))

## Docker

If you’d like to try out the latest version of the package on CRAN using
Docker, you can run the latest image with:

``` bash
docker run --rm -it nathaneastwood/poorman
```

([back to top](#readme-top))

## Usage

``` r

library(poorman, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
# 
#   I'd seen my father. He was a poor man, and I watched him do astonishing things.
#     - Sidney Poitier

mtcars %>%
  select(mpg, wt, starts_with("c")) %>%
  mutate(kpl = (1.609 * mpg) / 3.785, wt_kg = wt * 453.5924) %>%
  filter(mpg > 28)
#                 mpg    wt cyl carb      kpl    wt_kg
# Fiat 128       32.4 2.200   4    1 13.77321 997.9033
# Honda Civic    30.4 1.615   4    2 12.92301 732.5517
# Toyota Corolla 33.9 1.835   4    1 14.41086 832.3421
# Lotus Europa   30.4 1.513   4    2 12.92301 686.2853

mtcars %>%
  group_by(am, cyl) %>%
  summarise(mean_mpg = mean(mpg), sd_mpg = sd(mpg)) %>%
  ungroup()
#   am cyl mean_mpg    sd_mpg
# 1  0   4 22.90000 1.4525839
# 2  0   6 19.12500 1.6317169
# 3  0   8 15.05000 2.7743959
# 4  1   4 28.07500 4.4838599
# 5  1   6 20.56667 0.7505553
# 6  1   8 15.40000 0.5656854
```

([back to top](#readme-top))

## Related Work

- [{dplyr}](https://github.com/tidyverse/dplyr)
- [{bplyr}](https://github.com/yonicd/bplyr) - imports {magrittr} and
  {rlang}; it prepends functions with `b_*()`, e.g. `b_select()`.
- [{tbltools}](https://github.com/mkearney/tbltools) - imports
  {magrittr} and appends `*_data()` to each of its functions,
  e.g. `select_data()`.

([back to top](#readme-top))

# Package index

## One table verbs

- [`arrange()`](arrange.md) : Arrange rows by variables
- [`count()`](count.md) [`tally()`](count.md) [`add_count()`](count.md)
  [`add_tally()`](count.md) : Count observations by group
- [`distinct()`](distinct.md) : Subset distinct/unique rows
- [`fill()`](fill.md) : Fill in missing values with previous or next
  value
- [`filter()`](filter.md) : Return rows with matching conditions
- [`mutate()`](mutate.md) [`transmute()`](mutate.md) : Create or
  transform variables
- [`pull()`](pull.md) : Pull out a single variable
- [`relocate()`](relocate.md) : Change column order
- [`rename()`](rename.md) [`rename_with()`](rename.md) : Rename columns
- [`select()`](select.md) : Subset columns using their names and types
- [`summarise()`](summarise.md) [`summarize()`](summarise.md) : Reduce
  multiple values down to a single value
- [`slice()`](slice.md) [`slice_head()`](slice.md)
  [`slice_tail()`](slice.md) [`slice_min()`](slice.md)
  [`slice_max()`](slice.md) [`slice_sample()`](slice.md) : Subset rows
  by position
- [`unite()`](unite.md) : Unite Multiple Columns Into One

## Two table verbs

- [`bind_cols()`](bind.md) [`bind_rows()`](bind.md) :

  Efficiently bind multiple `data.frame`s by row and column

- [`anti_join()`](filter_joins.md) [`semi_join()`](filter_joins.md) :

  Filtering joins filter rows from `x` based on the presence or absence
  of matches in `y`:

- [`inner_join()`](mutate_joins.md) [`left_join()`](mutate_joins.md)
  [`right_join()`](mutate_joins.md) [`full_join()`](mutate_joins.md) :
  Mutating Joins

- [`union_all()`](union_all.md) : Union All

## Pivoting

- [`pivot_longer()`](pivot_longer.md) : Pivot data from wide to long
- [`pivot_wider()`](pivot_wider.md) : Pivot data from long to wide

## Grouping

- [`group_by()`](group_by.md) [`ungroup()`](group_by.md) : Group by one
  or more variables
- [`group_by_drop_default()`](group_by_drop_default.md) : Default value
  for .drop argument of group_by
- [`group_data()`](group_metadata.md)
  [`group_rows()`](group_metadata.md)
  [`group_indices()`](group_metadata.md)
  [`group_vars()`](group_metadata.md) [`groups()`](group_metadata.md)
  [`group_size()`](group_metadata.md) [`n_groups()`](group_metadata.md)
  : Grouping metadata
- [`group_split()`](group_split.md) [`group_keys()`](group_split.md) :
  Split data.frame by groups
- [`n()`](context.md) [`cur_data()`](context.md)
  [`cur_data_all()`](context.md) [`cur_group()`](context.md)
  [`cur_group_id()`](context.md) [`cur_group_rows()`](context.md)
  [`cur_column()`](context.md) : Context dependent expressions
- [`nest_by()`](nest_by.md) : Nest By
- [`with_groups()`](with_groups.md) : Perform an operation with
  temporary groups

## Vector functions

- [`across()`](across.md) [`if_any()`](across.md)
  [`if_all()`](across.md) : Apply a function (or functions) across
  multiple columns

- [`between()`](between.md) : Do values in a numeric vector fall in
  specified range?

- [`case_when()`](case_when.md) :

  A General Vetorised `if()`

- [`coalesce()`](coalesce.md) : Find first non-missing element

- [`cummean()`](cummean.md) [`cumany()`](cummean.md)
  [`cumall()`](cummean.md) : Cumulative versions of any, all, and mean

- [`desc()`](desc.md) : Descending order

- [`if_else()`](if_else.md) : Vectorised if

- [`lag()`](lag.md) [`lead()`](lag.md) : Compute lagged or leading
  values

- [`n_distinct()`](n_distinct.md) : Count the number of unique values in
  a set of vectors

- [`na_if()`](na_if.md) : Convert values to NA

- [`near()`](near.md) : Compare two numeric vectors

- [`nth()`](nth.md) [`first()`](nth.md) [`last()`](nth.md) : Extract the
  first, last or nth value from a vector

- [`recode()`](recode.md) [`recode_factor()`](recode.md) : Recode values

- [`replace_na()`](replace_na.md) : Replace missing values

- [`cume_dist()`](window_rank.md) [`dense_rank()`](window_rank.md)
  [`min_rank()`](window_rank.md) [`ntile()`](window_rank.md)
  [`percent_rank()`](window_rank.md) [`row_number()`](window_rank.md) :
  Windowed Rank Functions
